messages.content:
Write a single self-contained HTML file with a 3D voxel-art world using three.js. three.js r160 is available as an ES module at './three.module.js' -- import it with:
  import * as THREE from './three.module.js';
Build ALL of the following, procedurally, with no external assets:
1. Terrain: at least 64x64 voxel columns with clearly varied height (hills and a valley), grass on top, dirt/stone below, sand near water.
2. A river of blue water voxels that winds across the terrain from one edge to the opposite edge.
3. A village of at least 12 buildings using at least 3 visibly different building designs (different footprints, heights, roof shapes and colours), placed on the terrain surface, never floating and never underground.
4. A stone path connecting the buildings.
5. At least 20 trees (trunk + canopy) scattered on the grass.
6. A day/night toggle: pressing the 'N' key switches between a bright daytime sky/lighting and a dark night sky with warm lit windows on the buildings. Start in daytime.
7. An orbit camera that slowly auto-rotates around the village centre and keeps the whole village in frame; the whole world must be visible and fill most of the viewport.
Use instanced meshes or merged geometry so it runs smoothly. Everything must start immediately on load with no user interaction. Output ONLY the complete HTML in one code block.

reason: ✗scene drawn, ✗camera orbits, ✗water visible, ✗grass visible, ✗buildings/paths visible, ✗night toggle darkens
